In a shallow palate, the greater palatine artery lies only about 7 mm from the gingival margin. In an average palate it is about 12 mm, in a high palate about 17 mm. Palatal vault shape therefore affects how much tissue can be harvested safely for a connective tissue graft.

Source: Reiser GM, Bruno JF, Mahan PE, Larkin LH. The subepithelial connective tissue graft palatal donor site: anatomic considerations for surgeons. Int J Periodontics Restorative Dent. 1996;16(2):130-137. PMID 9084301
